name: Disable VBS / HVCI (memory integrity)
description: Turns off Virtualization-Based Security and Hypervisor-Enforced Code Integrity. On some CPUs this recovers a few percent FPS, at a REAL security cost: kernel exploit protections are weakened. Only for benchmarking or machines where you accept the tradeoff. Requires a reboot.
warning: THIS REDUCES YOUR SECURITY. VBS/HVCI protect the kernel against exploits; disabling them trades that protection for a small FPS gain. Windows may also re-enable memory integrity after major updates. ANTI-CHEAT NOTE: Riot Vanguard's 2026 Windows 11 baseline checks for VBS/HVCI enabled - disabling them can stop VALORANT from launching (not a ban; revert + reboot fixes it). Skip this tweak on machines that play VALORANT. Requires a reboot. Revert any time from Backups.
